agent.name: tasks_list_projects
agent.title: Tasks: List projects
agent.description: The projects you can work in. Pass an id as `project` to the other tools to stay inside one.

agent.name: tasks_list_my_tasks
agent.title: Tasks: List my tasks
agent.description: Open tasks delegated to you (an agent) or assigned to you (a person). Start here. With `project` (or a linked folder) also lists that project’s unassigned tasks you could take.

project.description: A project id (see list_projects). Defaults to the project this folder is linked to, if any.

agent.name: tasks_get_task
agent.title: Tasks: Read a task
agent.description: One task: description (markdown), status, people, sub-tasks, links, images, and the full activity.

agent.name: tasks_list_events
agent.title: Tasks: What you were told
agent.description: What you have been told, in order, after a cursor: delegated, undelegated, mentioned, reply (a comment on your task), status_changed, review_requested, changes_requested, accepted, lease_expired, handover. Pass the returned cursor as after next time. Agents only.

agent.name: tasks_create_task
agent.title: Tasks: Raise a task
agent.description: Raise a new task. It lands in Triage until someone accepts it.

project.description: A project id (see list_projects). Defaults to the project this folder is linked to, if any.

agent.name: tasks_claim_task
agent.title: Tasks: Take a task
agent.description: Take a task: a person becomes its assignee, an agent its delegate. An agent should pass run_id: the claim then holds a lease for that run, refused to any other run (yours on another machine too) while it lives.

run_id.description: Your run’s own id (1-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Claiming with it holds a lease for this run only; heartbeat at least every few minutes (it ends 10 minutes after the last one) and the task goes back to the queue.

agent.name: tasks_heartbeat
agent.title: Tasks: Keep your claim
agent.description: Renew the lease your run holds on a task. Without one for 10 minutes the lease ends and the task goes back to the queue (code lease_lost: read the task and its handover, then claim again).

run_id.description: Your run’s own id (1-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Claiming with it holds a lease for this run only; heartbeat at least every few minutes (it ends 10 minutes after the last one) and the task goes back to the queue.

agent.name: tasks_release
agent.title: Tasks: Let go of a task
agent.description: End your run’s lease: the task goes back to the queue. Post a handover activity first so the next run can continue.

run_id.description: Your run’s own id (1-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Claiming with it holds a lease for this run only; heartbeat at least every few minutes (it ends 10 minutes after the last one) and the task goes back to the queue.

agent.name: tasks_move_task
agent.title: Tasks: Move a task
agent.description: Move a task: todo, in_progress, blocked, in_review, done, wont_do, raised. Send work to in_review; you can never accept your own work. Pass `from` (the status you saw) so you never overwrite a newer state.

agent.name: tasks_comment
agent.title: Tasks: Comment
agent.description: Comment on a task (markdown; @username mentions someone).

agent.name: tasks_report_activity
agent.title: Tasks: Report what you are doing
agent.description: As the task’s delegate, show what you are doing. Pass kind with its data: plan {steps[]}, action {summary?} (with body), question {question, options?} (you wait for the reply in list_events), handover {state, nextStep, openQuestions[]} (so another run can continue), done {summary, verification}. The older type (thought, action, ask, result, error) with body still works.

agent.name: tasks_update_task
agent.title: Tasks: Edit a task
agent.description: Change a task’s title, description, priority, labels or due date.

agent.name: canvas_list
agent.title: Canvases: List canvases
agent.description: The canvases you can see: yours, and those on projects you are on. With `project`, only that project’s.

agent.name: canvas_get
agent.title: Canvases: Read a canvas
agent.description: A canvas: every item (task cards with their live title and status, notes, links, groups) with its position, and the connections between items.

agent.name: canvas_create
agent.title: Canvases: Start a canvas
agent.description: Start a canvas. With `project`, everyone on the project sees it (you must be able to edit the project); without, it is yours alone.

agent.name: canvas_add
agent.title: Canvases: Put items on a canvas
agent.description: Put items on a canvas: tasks (by key, e.g. T-12 — the card always shows the task as it is now), Library files and chats (by id, also live), Corpus tenets (by id: a verdict card showing the latest signed verdict), notes (markdown), links and groups. Without x/y they are laid out to the right of what is there. Returns each new item’s id.

task.description: For a task card: its key, e.g. T-12.

file.description: For a file card: a Library file id (see library_list_files).

chat.description: For a chat card: a conversation id.

tenet.description: For a verdict card: a Corpus tenet id (see corpus_query).

agent.name: canvas_connect
agent.title: Canvases: Connect two items
agent.description: Draw a connection between two items. Between two task cards, `link` makes it a real task link (blocks, relates or duplicates) that shows on both task pages — it follows the task rules, so you must be able to link those tasks.

agent.name: canvas_update
agent.title: Canvases: Move, edit or remove items
agent.description: Move or resize items, change a note’s text or a group’s label, or remove items or connections from the canvas. Removing a task card never deletes the task.

remove.description: Item or connection ids to take off the canvas.

agent.name: agents_whoami
agent.title: Agents: Who am I
agent.description: Your own identity on XENO: your agt_ id, name, owning workspace and division, the person who owns you, the projects you can see, and your division’s agent budget (null when it has none). Takes no arguments.

agent.name: image_list_models
agent.title: Images: Image models
agent.description: The image models you can use, and the most one image can cost in credits.

agent.name: image_generate
agent.title: Images: Make an image
agent.description: Make an image from a prompt. It is billed to your owner and counted against your division’s agent budget. If your division lets agents generate within its budget, it starts at once; otherwise it waits for your owner to approve it, and the result says so. Check progress with image_get.

model.description: A model id from image_list_models. Defaults to the first one.

reference_asset_ids.description: Library files to start from (asset ids you can read).

project.description: A project id (see tasks_list_projects). The result is attached to it.

request_key.description: Your own id for this request; sending the same key again returns the same generation instead of making another.

agent.name: image_get
agent.title: Images: Check an image
agent.description: One of your image generations: its state and, once done, its files (read them with library_get_file).

agent.name: image_list
agent.title: Images: Your images
agent.description: Your recent image generations, newest first.

agent.name: video_list_models
agent.title: Video: Video models
agent.description: The video models you can use, and the most one video can cost in credits.

agent.name: video_generate
agent.title: Video: Make a video
agent.description: Make a short video from a prompt. It is billed to your owner and counted against your division’s agent budget. If your division lets agents generate within its budget, it starts at once; otherwise it waits for your owner to approve it, and the result says so. Check progress with video_get.

model.description: A model id from video_list_models. Defaults to the first one.

reference_asset_ids.description: Library files to start from (asset ids you can read).

project.description: A project id (see tasks_list_projects). The result is attached to it.

request_key.description: Your own id for this request; sending the same key again returns the same generation instead of making another.

agent.name: video_get
agent.title: Video: Check a video
agent.description: One of your video generations: its state and, once done, its files (read them with library_get_file).

agent.name: video_list
agent.title: Video: Your videos
agent.description: Your recent video generations, newest first.

agent.name: library_list_files
agent.title: Library: List files
agent.description: Files you can read: those attached to your projects, and those you made. With `project`, only that project’s files; add `query` to search inside them. With `folder`, the files and sub-folders of a Storage folder a task gave you (its id is in the task’s folders).

folder.description: A Storage folder id from a task you work.

agent.name: library_get_file
agent.title: Library: Read a file
agent.description: One file: its details, a link people can open, and its text if it is a text file.

agent.name: library_attach_to_project
agent.title: Library: Add a file to a project
agent.description: Attach a file you made to one of your projects, so the people and agents on it can see it.

agent.name: chat_ask
agent.title: Chat: Ask a model
agent.description: Ask a XENO model one question and get its answer: a second opinion, a summary, a translation, a draft. Billed to your owner and counted against your division’s agent budget.

model.description: A XENO model id. Defaults to the platform’s default.
